About

Your trusted international partner

Succeeding internationally doesn't happen by chance: cultural barriers, customs regulations, payment risks, partner reliability. Our role is to spare you unpleasant surprises and open the right doors.

With over 20 years of experience, we support companies in their trade with Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Middle East. We work in automotive, industry and food, and we have worked with major international brands.

We work in French, English and Spanish, which makes communication easier across Asia, Africa and Latin America. You save time, reduce your risks and keep your energy focused on your core business.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Answers to the questions we are asked most often.

Who are your services for?

SMEs, traders, distributors and entrepreneurs who want to buy or sell in Asia, Africa, Latin America or the Middle East, whether they are just starting out or already growing their trade.

What types of products do you handle?

Mainly automotive, industry and food. Tell us what you need and we will tell you whether we can help.

Can we talk before committing?

Yes, the first call is without obligation. It helps us understand your project and see how we can help.

An import or export project?

Tell us about it. The first call is without obligation.
